cards.title: What Plant Maintenance covers across plant operations
cards.body:
Plant Maintenance oversees the reliability, safety, and operational upkeep of company assets.
It manages the equipment register, maintenance requests, scheduled overhauls, and work permits.
The module ensures machinery operates safely while tracking maintenance costs and downtime.

cards.title: The core preventive and breakdown maintenance lifecycle
cards.body:
Maintenance begins with defining work permit safety templates and equipment master records.
Operational breakdowns or periodic schedules trigger maintenance requests and formal work orders.
Technicians consume engineering spares from warehouse stock and record job execution times.

cards.title: Centralized equipment register and physical tracking
cards.body:
The equipment register maintains comprehensive records for all owned, hired, and leased machinery.
It tracks technical specifications, physical operating locations, serial numbers, and custodians.
Historical logs capture running hours, breakdown incidents, and component replacement histories.

cards.title: Work permits enforce hazardous job safety and equipment isolation
cards.body:
High-risk maintenance activities mandate approved work permits before execution begins.
Permits specify electrical lockout, mechanical tagout, and mandatory protective procedures.
Authorized clearance ensures personnel safety before technicians begin physical repair work.

cards.title: Where Plant Maintenance connects with Material Management
cards.body:
Plant Maintenance coordinates with Material Management stores to supply replacement spares.
Approved maintenance orders generate internal material requisitions for stocked engineering parts.
Storekeepers issue parts against work orders, charging consumption costs to the equipment.

cards.title: Meter readings and operational utilization tracking
cards.body:
Technicians record operating hours, odometer values, and production run times on machinery.
Cumulative utilization triggers usage-based preventive maintenance overhauls automatically.
Abnormal operating readings alert supervisors to potential equipment failures early.

cards.title: Customer equipment service calls and external repair contracts
cards.body:
Service teams record field service requests for client-owned or leased installations.
Contract terms define warranty coverage, preventive service visits, and billing rates.
External repair orders track outside contractor interventions on specialized factory machinery.
